# Vendored player assets

- hls.js 1.7.3 — Apache-2.0, see `hls.js.LICENSE`
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.7.3/dist/hls.min.js
- Artplayer 5.4.0 — MIT, see `artplayer.LICENSE`
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artplayer@5.4.0/dist/artplayer.js
- artplayer-plugin-danmuku 5.3.0 — MIT, see `artplayer-plugin-danmuku.LICENSE`
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/artplayer-plugin-danmuku@5.3.0/dist/artplayer-plugin-danmuku.js

Artplayer and its plugin inject their own styles at runtime; no separate CSS
file is shipped in their npm distributions.
